verdict.rationale: Attio's pricing page lists "Automatic data enrichment" as a built-in feature, even on the entry tier. The workflows page shows a Web Agent step that "enriches the record with web research," and company records carry standard attributes such as Industry. However, the evidence is only marketing bullets, with no documentation of what is enriched or how. missing for 10: documentation of which firmographic and contact fields are auto-populated on people and company records, confirmation that enrichment runs automatically on contact records as well as companies, data sources and coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
